scope: Four targeted historical-event objects: December 2021, December 2022 and the Haitong / China Shipbuilding temporary changes in 2025. No claim of complete historical membership.
key_conclusions: The 15-in/15-out candidate dated 2023-03-20 exactly matches a screenshot of the official CSI change table reproduced by Securities Times for the December 2022 rebalance. The same article explicitly reports effectiveness after the 2022-12-09 close. Treat 2023-03-20 as an observation/version date, not the effective membership date.

The 28-in/28-out candidate dated 2022-01-17 corresponds at the name level to the December 2021 list in a China Securities Journal table citing CSI and Wind, reprinted by Sina. A contemporaneous Securities Times bulletin reports effectiveness after 2021-12-10 close. This is name-level corroboration, not direct original code verification.

The full exported 2022-01-04 candidate anchor has 300 unique codes. Under the explicitly disclosed name-to-candidate-code mapping it retains all 28 December-2021 reported removals and omits all 28 additions. This fails a targeted staleness test; it does not establish a corrected complete official anchor.
Public reports independently give 2025-03-04 for Sailun admission and 2025-09-05 for Qingdao Port admission. Formal CSI replacement notices and exact removal/inclusion binding remain missing.
